record.title: OCORRÊNCIA E CARACTERIZAÇÃO MOLECULAR DE ESPÉCIES DE Babesia EM CÃES DE UMA POPULAÇÃO HOSPITALAR DA REGIÃO DE LONDRINA, PR.
record.journal: Revista Brasileira de Parasitologia Veterinária/Brazilian Journal of Veterinary Parasitology
record.abstract: Canine babesiosis is a worldwide disease caused by the protozoan of Babesia genus. Babesia canis and B.gibsoni are both species that naturally infect dogs. T...

screening.species: B. vogeli and B. gibsoni (confirmed, PCR-RFLP)
screening.rationale: Based on the full text (Redalyc PDF; RBPV 17 Suppl 1:277-283, full article): 282 hospital dogs with cytopenias were screened by PCR. The paper tabulates anaemia, thrombocytopenia and leukopenia patterns in PCR-positive vs PCR-negative dogs and by species, so this survey also reports haematology of infected dogs.
screening.rescue_reason: Occurrence and molecular characterisation of Babesia in a hospital dog population, with a truncated abstract. The title suggests a molecular survey, but the abstract cannot rule out haematology or clinical data from hospital cases, so the adjudicator should check the full text.
